info.title: OpenVideoLibrary API
info.description: Native Rust preview API. No Jellyfin API compatibility. List reads omit entries whose media are inaccessible; positions retain saved ordering. Cursor is the next saved position for queues. Updates replace entries atomically and require the current Revision; stale writes return 409. Limits: 100 lists per account and 1000 entries per list. Expansion tables are additive to database schema v2.

200.description: Lyrics or empty lines when absent

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Exact album artist, at most 800 UTF-8 bytes.

parameters.name: album
parameters.description: Exact album title, at most 800 UTF-8 bytes. An empty value returns no matches. Omit to include all tracks by a named artist, including tracks without an album.

start.description: Source position, in seconds, at which the returned stream begins. Remux sessions start at the latest video keyframe at or before the requested Start, so this can be earlier than the request; clients add it to the stream's current time.

disposition.description: FFprobe flags for artwork and timed thumbnail tracks.

sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz as reported by FFprobe, or an empty string when unavailable.

channels.description: FFprobe audio channel count; zero means unavailable or not an audio stream.

start_time.description: Raw source timestamp origin in seconds from FFprobe, or empty if unavailable. Playback Start is relative to this origin.

tags.description: Bounded display metadata for audio-only media (title, artist, album, album_artist, track and disc).

containers.description: Playable direct containers. Include hls alongside aac to accept AAC HLS music conversion.

video_pixel_formats.description: Optional per-codec FFprobe pixel format allowlists. An omitted codec uses the conservative 8-bit 4:2:0 baseline; an empty list rejects all source pixel formats for that codec. Unknown source pixel formats require transcoding. This does not establish profile/level, resolution, frame-rate or device acceptance.

max_audio_sample_rate.description: Optional audio sample-rate ceiling in Hz for automatic negotiation and AAC output.

max_audio_channels.description: Maximum source audio channels for automatic direct playback. Omitted or null reports use a conservative two-channel limit; unknown source channels require conversion. HLS converts to AAC with at most two channels, or mono when the limit is one. This does not certify channel layouts, passthrough or device decoding.

entry_count.description: Total saved entries, including entries hidden by current access or media availability.
